data.title: Grundsicherung im Alter approved from December 2026
data.summary: The Kreisverwaltung Beispiel-Westerwald (Sozialamt, Grundsicherung im Alter) approved monthly basic subsistence support (Grundsicherung im Alter) of €412.64 starting December 2026, after offsetting the recipient's pension income of €768.36 and covering the full rent.
data.explanation: This letter confirms that you have been granted Grundsicherung im Alter (basic subsistence support for older people) of €412.64 per month from December 2026; your pension and your full rent were already taken into account. If you disagree with how the amount was calculated, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Kreisverwaltung — the app shows until when based on the deadline rule stated in the letter. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final. There is also an optional, free information session on 31 December 2026 you may attend if you want to learn more; attending is not required.
